entries.toelichting: Small-silver-payment-unit for bread; 1Sam 2:36.
Who-begets-father-drops-of-dew; Job 38:28.
Proper noun, Moabite place of lamentation; Isa 15:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eglaim.

Standing-water-pool surrounded-by reed-or-rush distinguished from yam (sea), tehom (deep), bor (cistern, H953a) by the reed-bordered-marsh-character (Ex 7:19, 8:1,5 plague 'Aaron's-staff over-the-waters-of-Egypt, over-rivers, over-Niles, over-pools and-on-all-collections-of-water', Ps 107:35 'He-makes wilderness into reed-pool-water and-dry-land into springs-of-water', 114:8 'Rock turning-into reed-pool-water, flint-into water-fountain', Isa 14:23 Babel-judgment 'I-will-make-her into-possession-of hedgehogs and reed-pools-of-water', 35:7 'parched-place shall-become reed-pool and-thirsty-land springs-of-water', 41:18 'in-high-places I-open rivers and-in-the-midst-of valleys springs, I-will-make-the-wilderness into reed-pool-water and-dry-land into water-springs', 42:15 'I-will-dry-up mountains and-hills and-all-their-herbage I-will-wither, and-I-make rivers into-islands and reed-pools I-will-dry-up'); concordantly 'reed-pool' distinguishes the reed-environment-aspect from a plain pool.
Hire-workers grieving in Egypt; Isa 19:10.

Pliable water-rush or rush-cord (Job 40:26; 41:12; Isa 9:13; 19:15; 58:5). Hyphenated to distinguish the rush-reed-aspect from H7070 qaneh 'reed' and H5488 suph 'reed-grass'; family with H98 agam 'pool'.

Sacrificial blood-basins at Sinai and fountain-bowl (Ex 24:6; Song 7:2; Isa 22:24). Concordantly hyphenated to distinguish the basin-bowl-cup-aspect from H4219 mizraq sprinkling-basin, H3713a kefor-I bowl and H5592 saph-II threshold-bowl. Occurrence-correction: 3 instead of 4 (audit-2026-04-26).

Military-troops surrounding king or commander; all 7 occurrences in Ezekiel (12:14; 17:21; 38:6 [2x], 38:9, 38:22, 39:4) at Gog-army and Egypt-king. Fully restored after duplicate-audit 2026-04-26: master had erroneously contained aggan-bowl data (H101-overlap).

Wine-harvest-not-gathered and ant-harvest-collecting and son-harvest-time (Deut 28:39; Prov 6:8; 10:5). Hyphenated to distinguish the gather-harvest-collect-store-up-aspect from H622 asaph 'gather-in' (already assigned) and H6908 qavats 'gather' (already assigned) and H3950 laqat 'pick-up-glean' (already assigned); harvest-technical.

The ordinary Aramaic designation for letter or missive - Ezra 4:8, 4:11, 5:6; Aramaic parallel to Hebrew iggeret H107 (already assigned); distinguished from H5407 nishtevana as the more official rescript-designation.
The gold and silver offering-bowls that Cyrus handed over to Sheshbazzar for the temple-treasury - Ezra 1:9 (29 knives, 30 bowls, 1000 silver bowls); Persian loanword.

Ex-when-men-strive-and-one-strikes-his-neighbour-with-stone-or-fist and Isa-to-strike-with-godless-fist (Ex 21:18; Isa 58:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the fist-clenched-hand-strike-aspect from other hand-terms; quarrel-violence-distinction-bodily-injury.

Written written-message distinguished from sefer (book-scroll) and ketav (writing) (2Chr 30:1,6 Hezekiah's letter-to-Israel for-Passover, Neh 2:7-9 Nehemiah's-letters to-governors of-Beyond-the-River and to-Asaph-keeper-of-the-forest, 6:5,17,19 Sanballat's hostile-letter and-counter-letters, Esth 9:26,29 letter-about-Purim 'second letter'); concordantly 'letter' marks specific-written-correspondence.

Gen-mist-arose-from-the-earth-watered and Job-drawn-up-vapours-from-the-sea (Gen 2:6; Job 36:27). Hyphenated to distinguish the mist-vapour-rising-moisture-aspect from H5707 ed 'witness' (already assigned) as homograph; natural-water-cycle-oldest-creation.
Hiphil-infinitive; I will cause your soul heart-grief; 1Sam 2:33.

Gen-sons-Ishmael-Nebajoth-Kedar-Adbeel-Mibsam and 1Chr-Ishmael-Adbeel (Gen 25:13; 1Chr 1:29). Hyphenated to distinguish the Adbeel-son-Ishmael-Arabian-tribe-aspect from others; North-Arabian-tribe-eponym-Assyrian-Idiba'il.
Proper noun, Edomite prince; 1Kgs 11:17; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hadad (variant).

The Aramaic adverb 'then' or 'at that moment' - Ezra 4:9, 4:23-24, 5:4, 6:1-13 in the narrative-connecting function; Aramaic, distinguished from H5732 iddan-aramaic (duration-period, already assigned) by the discrete-moment-aspect.

Unique lexeme. Master-form; in vocative 1cs-form adonay (H136). 'Lord' standard - covers both the secular master sense and the divine title. The lowercase form is held; capitalisation is rendering, not lexical.
Proper noun, Babylonian place of returnees without genealogy; Neh 7:61; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Addon.
Proper noun, Judah-fortress-city built by Rehoboam; 2Chr 11:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adoraim.
Aramaic adverb: then, thereupon; concordantly 'then'.
From √adar (to be majestic); majestic, noble; concordantly 'mighty'.
Proper noun, fifth son of Haman; Esth 9:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adalia.

Ram-skins to dye-red or to blush (Ex 25:5; 26:14; 35:7; 36:19; 39:34; Lam 4:7; Nah 2:4). Hyphenated; distinguishes the colouring-action from H120 adam 'human' (noun) and H122a adom 'red-coloured' (adjective).

Root 'dm (to be red); connection with adamah (ground, H127). 'Human' covers both the generic ('humanity') and the individual; the proper noun Adam is a homograph. 'Human' chosen over 'man' to preserve the gender-neutral kernel - the Hebrew adam is grammatically masculine but semantically inclusive (Gen 1:27 'male and female he created them' both within ha-adam).

First human as proper noun (Gen 4:25, 5:1-5 'this is the register of generations of Adam', 1Chr 1:1 genealogy-start, Deut 32:8 'when the Most High gave the nations their inheritance... according to the number of the sons of Adam/Mighty', Job 31:33 'hide-as-Adam', Ps 68:19 = Eph 4:8 context, Hos 6:7 'you like Adam transgressed the covenant', Josh 3:16 place-Adam); concordantly transliterated, distinguished from adam (human, H120).
Colour-state 'red' of stone, skin or horse (Num 19:2; 2Kgs 3:22; Prov 23:31; Song 5:10; Isa 63:2; Lam 4:7; Zech 1:8; 6:2). Distinguishes adjective from H119 adam-II 'redden' (verb).

Zech-russet-horses-and-bay-and-white and Zech-first-chariot-red-horses-second-black (Zech 1:8; 6:2 cf). Hyphenated to distinguish the sorrel-russet-horse-colour-aspect from H122a adom-general-red-colour (already assigned) as specific-horse-colour-shade; Zechariah-vision-horses-colour-palette.
Proper noun. English convention Edom.

Ex-first-row-ruby-topaz-emerald and Eze-ruby-topaz-jasper-chrysolite (Ex 28:17; 39:10; Eze 28:13). Hyphenated to distinguish the ruby-carnelian-red-gem-aspect from H122a adom 'red' (already assigned); family-same-root-red-stone-breastplate-priest-Reuben-tribe.
Reddish tint at skin-disease-spot (Lev 13:19,24,42,43,49; 14:37). Hyphenated to preserve tint-gradation-colour-on-skin; family with H119 adom 'be-red' and H122 adom 'red'.
One of the five cities of Sodom's plain (Gen 10:19; 14:2,8; Deut 29:22; Hos 11:8). English convention: Admah.
Root 'dm (to be red); linked to adam (H120). 'Ground' as red-earth; 'land' (H776) is broader territorial.
Proper noun, Naphtali-city; Josh 19:36; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adamah.
Proper noun, Naphtali-border-place; Josh 19:33; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adami-nekeb.

Ethnonym-adjective of Edom (H123) - inhabitant-or-descendant of-Esau-people (Gen 36:9,21,31, Deut 23:8 'you-shall-not-abhor an Edomite for he-is-your-brother'), Saul's slaughter-Nob-servant (1Sam 21:8 'Doeg the Edomite chief-shepherd of-Saul'), political-opposition (2Sam 8:14, 1Kgs 11:14-17 'Hadad the Edomite of royal-seed of-Edom'), esp. in Ps 7-title 'of-David concerning-Cush the-Benjamite'; concordantly 'Edomite' distinguishes ethnonym-suffix -i from country-name.

Josh-border-went-up-toward-Debir-from-the-valley-of-Achor-and-northward-looking-toward-Gilgal-which-is-opposite-the-ascent-of-Adummim and Josh-border-came-down-along-the-eastern-side-toward-Gilgal-which-is-opposite-the-ascent-of-Adummim (Josh 15:7; 18:17). Hyphenated to distinguish the Adummim-ascent-border-Judah-Benjamin-aspect from other Edom-related-names; border-Judah-Benjamin-paired-ascent-name-'ascent-of-the-red-ones'.

Gen-Esau-came-out-ruddy-all-like-a-hairy-mantle and 1Sam-David-was-ruddy-with-fair-eyes-and-handsome-of-appearance (Gen 25:25; 1Sam 16:12; 17:42). Hyphenated to distinguish the ruddy-red-tinge-complexion-aspect from H122a adom 'red' (already assigned); family with H119 adam 'become-red' (already assigned) - red-complexion-person-description.
Proper noun, Persian counsellor third position; Esth 1:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Admatha.
Base-piece in which tabernacle-boards rest; concordantly 'socket-base'; distinguished from the proper noun Adonai.
Proper noun, Babylonian place of returnees without genealogy-proof; Ezra 2:59; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Addan.
Proper-noun-form of adon (H113). Morphologically 1cs-pronominal: literally 'my-lord(s)'. 'My-Lord' with hyphen preserves the morphological composition.
Adoni-Bezek-king-of-Bezek-captured-by-Judah-thumbs-toes-cut-off (Judg 1:5,6,7). English convention: Adoni-bezek. 'Lord-of-Bezek' (adon-lord + Bezeq-city).
Proper noun ('my-Lord-is-YHWH'); son of David; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adonijah.

Josh-Adoni-Zedek-king-of-Jerusalem-heard-that-Joshua-took-Ai and Josh-Adoni-Zedek-sent-to-Hoham-king-Hebron-to-Piram-king-Jarmuth (Josh 10:1,3). Hyphenated to distinguish the Adoni-Zedek-king-Jerusalem-coalition-aspect from other kings; family with H113 adon 'lord' (already assigned) - 'lord-of-my-righteousness'-theophoric-five-kings-coalition-Josh-10.
Adonikam-family-head-of-returnees-from-exile-six-hundred-sixty-six (Ezra 2:13; 8:13; Neh 7:18). English convention: Adonikam. 'My-Lord-has-arisen' (adon-lord + qum-arise already assigned).
Proper noun, Solomon's-tribute-overseer; 1Kgs 4:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Adoniram.

Ex-Your-right-hand-LORD-glorious-in-power and Ps-how-excellent-is-Your-Name-in-all-the-earth (Ex 15:10; Ps 8:2,10). Hyphenated to distinguish the mighty-excellent-noble-aspect from H117 addir 'ruler-illustrious' (already assigned) as attributive-form; victory-song-Moses-God-majesty.
Twelfth month of the Jewish calendar, name from the Persian period (Ezra 6:15; Esth 3:7,13; 8:12; 9:1,15,17,19,21). Month-name untranslated; no hyphen.
Aramaic-proper-noun twelfth month (Feb/Mar); Ezra 6:15; concordantly transliterated.

Proper noun Eder, son of Mushi from the Merari-Levites - in 1Chronicles 23:23 (the children of Mushi were Mahli and Eder and Jeremoth, three) and 1Chronicles 24:30 (the children of Mushi were Mahli and Eder and Jerimoth); distinguished from H145a eder-I (flock) by personal-name-reference.

Josh-border-went-out-southward-to-the-ascent-of-Akrabbim-passed-along-Zin-went-up-from-south-to-Kadesh-Barnea-went-through-Hezron-went-up-to-Addar and Num-border-turned-toward-Hatsar-Addar-went-through-Azmon (Josh 15:3; Num 34:4 cf). Hyphenated to distinguish the Addar-border-city-Judah-south-aspect from other Addar-names; south-border-promised-land-border-Judah-Num-34-Josh-15-pair.
Aramaic threshing-floor (Dan 2:35 summer-threshing-floors); cognate Hebrew H1637 goren different stem.

Aramaic loanword for counsellor or supreme commander - in Daniel 3:2 (the satraps, the prefects, the governors) and Daniel 3:3 (the satraps, the prefects, the governors); officials-list at Nebuchadnezzar's image-dedication.
Aramaic-Persian loanword 'with-great-care'; Ezra 7:23.
Persian gold-piece weight; Ezra 8:27.

2Sam-Adoram-was-over-the-tribute and 1Kgs-king-Rehoboam-sent-Adoram-who-was-over-the-tribute (2Sam 20:24; 1Kgs 12:18). Hyphenated to distinguish the Adoram-corvee-overseer-aspect from other Adoni-names; family with H113 adon 'lord' (already assigned) - 'lord-is-exalted'-overseer-corvee-stoned-Rehoboam-secession.

2Kgs-and-the-Sepharvites-burned-their-sons-with-fire-to-Adrammelech-and-Anammelech-the-gods-of-Sepharvaim and 2Kgs-and-Adrammelech-and-Sharezer-his-sons-struck-him-with-the-sword (2Kgs 17:31; 19:37). Hyphenated to distinguish the Adrammelech-Sepharvite-god-and-son-Sennacherib-aspect from other Mlk-names; family with H142 adir 'mighty' and H4428 melek 'king' (both already assigned) - 'mighty-king-god-name'-Mesopotamian-cult-child-sacrifice-Sennacherib-murder-son-Nisroch-temple-Esarhaddon-successor.
Aramaic arm-with-strength (Ezra 4:23 Persian-army-arm); variant H1872 dera.
Capital of Og, king of Bashan (Num 21:33; Deut 1:4; 3:1,10; Josh 12:4; 13:12,31; 19:37). Aramaic 'mighty'. English convention: Edrei.
From √adar (to be glorious); splendid-garment (Elijah's mantle, Joseph's blood-mantle); the hyphenated English marks size and dignity.
Bread-grain is-threshed and-not-endlessly; Isa 28:28.
Root 'hb. 'Love' is the kernel-activity; derived ahavah (love, H160).
The love or caresses - Proverbs 5:19 (let her breasts intoxicate you at all times, wander always in her love) and Hosea 8:9 (Ephraim has hired lovers); from H157 ahav (to love).
Adulterous-woman calls for-love-making; Prov 7:18.
From √ahav (to love); strong devotion between persons or to YHWH; concordantly 'love'.

Gen-sons-Simeon-Jemuel-Jamin-Ohad-Jachin-Zohar and Ex-sons-Simeon-Jemuel-Jamin-Ohad (Gen 46:10; Ex 6:15). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ohad-son-Simeon-tribe-head-aspect from others; Simeon-third-son-not-in-Num-26-numbering.
Onomatopoeic lament-cry of fright/distress (Josh 7:7, Judg 6:22, Jer 1:6 'Alas, Lord YHWH!', Eze 4:14, Joel 1:15); concordantly 'Alas!' as English equivalent-interjection.
Ahava-river-where-Ezra-people-gathered-for-return-from-Babylon (Ezra 8:15,21,31). English convention: Ahava. Babylonian-Aramaic-toponym-possibly-tributary-of-the-Euphrates.

Benjamite judge-deliverer of-Israel from-Moab-king-Eglon via-assassination (Judg 3:15-16,20-21,23,26 core-account 'sons-of-Israel cried to-YHWH, and-YHWH gave-them a-deliverer: Ehud son-of-Gera the-Benjamite, a-man bound at-his-right-hand; and-the-sons-of-Israel sent by-his-hand a-tribute to-Eglon-king-of-Moab; and-Ehud-made-himself a-sword that-had-two-edges length-of-a-cubit, and-he-girded-it under-his-clothes upon-his-right-thigh... Ehud-came-to-him, and-he sat in-a-cool-chamber upper-alone; and-Ehud-said: a-word-of-God I-have-to-you; and-he-rose up from-his-throne; and-Ehud put-out his-left-hand and-took-the-sword from-his-right-thigh and-thrust-it-into his-belly', 4:1 death-Ehud 'when Ehud died, the-sons-of-Israel did again the-evil in-the-eyes-of YHWH'), 1Chr 7:10, 8:6 Benjamite-genealogy); concordantly transliterated; distinguished from H261 Ehud.

Hos-where-is-your-king-that-he-may-save-you and Hos-where-are-your-rulers and Hos-I-am-where-is-your-plague (Hos 13:10 twice, 13:14). Hyphenated to distinguish the where-is-he-where-then-where-aspect from H346 ayyeh 'where-is' (already assigned) as variant-question-word; Hosea-exclusively-rhetorical-question.
Hiphil; even moon-not-bright before God; Job 25:5.

Abraham-pitching-tents and city-without-tent (Gen 13:12,18; Isa 13:20). Hyphenated to distinguish the pitch-tent-take-up-aspect from H3427 yashav 'dwell' (already assigned) and H7931 shakhan 'tabernacle' (already assigned); family with H168 ohel 'tent' (already assigned).
Unique lexeme. 'Tent' standard.
Proper noun, son of Zerubbabel; 1Chr 3:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ohel.
Symbolic name for Samaria in Eze 23 (Eze 23:4,5,36,44). English convention: Oholah. 'Her-tent'; family with H168 ohel 'tent'.
Danite tent-maker-helper of Bezalel at the tabernacle-construction (Ex 31:6; 35:34; 36:1,2; 38:23). English convention: Oholiab. 'Tent-of-father'.
Allegorical name for Jerusalem in Ezekiel's narrative (Eze 23:4,11,22,36,44). 'My-tent-is-in-her'. English convention: Oholibah.
Wife of Esau, Hittite; also tribe-head-name in Edom-lists (Gen 36:2,5,14,18,25,41; 1Chr 1:52). 'Tent-of-the-high-place'. English convention: Oholibamah.
Fragrant-wood as perfume or image (Num 24:6; Ps 45:9; Prov 7:17; Song 4:14). Hyphenated to distinguish the aloe-fragrance-aspect from H168 ohel 'tent' and H3828 levonah 'frankincense'.
Proper noun. English convention Aaron.
Disjunctive conjunction. 'Or' standard.
Second-sense o; and-not-for-princes-strong-drink; Prov 31:4.
Proper noun, son of Bani who took foreign-wife; Ezra 10:34; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Uel.
Diviner who consults the spirits of the deceased (Saul at Endor); the noun marks the profession. Distinguished from H3049 yidoni 'familiar-spirit-knower'.
Proper noun, Ishmaelite David's-camel-overseer; 1Chr 27:30; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Obil.

Dan-by-the-Ulai-river and Dan-vision-along-the-stream and Dan-before-Ulai-watercourse (Dan 8:2,3,6). Hyphenated to distinguish the watercourse-stream-aspect from H5104 nahar 'river' (already assigned) and H5158 nachal 'brook' (already assigned); family with H2975 yeor 'Nile-canal' (already assigned) - specific-Ulai-Elam-water-channel.

Amos-as-firebrand-out-of-the-burning-saved and Zech-firebrand-snatched-from-fire and Isa-smoking-firebrand-piece (Amos 4:11; Zech 3:2; Isa 7:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the firebrand-glowing-firewood-coal-furnace-aspect from H5749b ud 'witnesses' (already assigned) and H6086 ets 'tree-wood' (already assigned) and H1197a ba'ar 'burn' (already assigned) and H6352 pecham 'charcoal' (also-this-batch); rescue-from-fire-metaphor.
Substantive 'cause/reason', always in construct 'al-odot' = 'on-account-of' (Gen 21:11,25, 26:32, Ex 18:8, Num 12:1, 13:24, Josh 14:6, Judg 6:7, Jer 3:8); concordantly 'cause' as lemma.
Piel/Hithpael: strong longing, fierce craving (not always negative); concordantly 'crave'. Distinguished from H14 avah 'be-willing' (homonym different root).
Hithpael; land-border to-trace-out; Num 34:10.

Intense inward longing for food or matter (Gen 3:16 (?); Num 11:4,34; Deut 12:15,20,21; 14:26; 18:6; Job 23:13; Ps 78:29,30; Isa 26:8; Hos 10:10; Mic 7:3). Hyphenated; intensification of H183 avah 'crave'.
Father of wall-builder Palal Neh 3:25; short proper noun, uncertain meaning.
Uzal-son-of-Joktan and Tyre-trade-partner (Gen 10:27; 1Chr 1:21; Eze 27:19). English convention: Uzal. Possibly Arabic-Sana (old capital of Yemen).
Lament-cry at calamity or judgment; the hyphenated English marks the exclamation-function.

Num-killed-with-their-slain-Evi-Rekem-Zur-Hur-Reba-five-kings-Midian and Josh-Evi-Rekem-Zur-Hur-Reba-kings-Sihon-Amorite-who-dwelt-in-the-land (Num 31:8; Josh 13:21). Hyphenated to distinguish the Evi-king-Midian-defeated-aspect from other names; Midianite-five-kings-list-first-name-Moses-war.
Woe-is-me that I sojourn in Meshech; Ps 120:5.
Moral fool in wisdom-literature, coarse and unbending; concordantly 'fool' (distinguished from kesil, sakhal).

2Kgs-and-it-came-to-pass-in-the-thirty-seventh-year-of-the-captivity-of-Jehoiachin-the-king-of-Judah-in-the-twelfth-month-when-Evil-merodach-the-king-of-Babylon-received-the-kingdom and Jer-id (2Kgs 25:27; Jer 52:31 par). Hyphenated to distinguish the Evil-Merodach-Babylonian-king-Jehoiachin-release-aspect from other Mrdk-names; Akkadian-Amel-Marduk-son-Nebuchadnezzar-amnesty-Jewish-king-37th-exile-year-table-of-honour-king-gate-final-verse-2Kgs-hope-remnant.
